name: researchx
description: Literature-grounded research assistant: paper analysis, gap and method mining, experiment design, manuscript writing, PRISMA reviews, peer review, grants — every citation verified against Crossref/OpenAlex/arXiv.

interface.shortDescription: Research assistant with verified citations — from gap finding to submission.
interface.longDescription: ResearchX runs the whole research loop: mine the literature for gaps and methods, design experiments, write and upgrade the manuscript, stress-test it with an adversarial peer review, build the literature matrix or a PRISMA systematic review, produce figures and graphical abstracts, package the artifact, and write the grant. Its distinguishing rule: no reference reaches you until Crossref/OpenAlex/arXiv confirm it, and unverifiable references are labelled instead of invented.
defaultPrompt: Find a publishable research gap in my field and propose five topics with literature-backed methods.
Check every reference in my draft and tell me which ones are real.
Run a systematic review on this question with PRISMA counts and a screening ledger.
